report.headline: Above-average NBA usage projects to a high-usage EuroLeague role, but the shooting-efficiency projection carries no real signal.

projection.text: Projected usage rate in the EuroLeague is 25.0%, about 4.4 percentage points (roughly one standard deviation) above the league average of 20.6%, up from 21.2% usage in the NBA source season.

risks.text: The projected true shooting percentage of 58.4% cannot be trusted: the model's error (4.7%) is no better than simply guessing the EuroLeague average (58.0%, also 4.7% error), so this figure carries no real signal despite sitting close to league norms.

The 95% interval for usage runs from 18.3% to 31.7%, a 13.4-point range against a league standard deviation of just 4.4%—over three standard deviations wide—underscoring that the model can rank this player as high-usage but not price the exact share.

The historical cohort of NBA->EL movers this estimate is built from sat 0.31 standard deviations below their own league's average, the opposite direction from this player's own +0.23 sd standing, so the projection extrapolates somewhat beyond the typical profile the model was fit on.

strengths.text: Usage rate is projected to rise from 21.2% in the NBA to 25.0% in the EuroLeague, and the model is well-suited to this metric, beating the trivial league-mean baseline (3.3% vs 4.3% mean absolute error).

The subject entered above the NBA average in usage (+0.23 sd), and the model's fitted slope of 0.986 for usage means nearly all of that standing above the NBA average is expected to carry over to the EuroLeague.
The source-season sample is substantial and uninterrupted: 82 games and 2,117 minutes played.

uncertainty.text: The 80% prediction interval for usage spans 20.6% to 29.4%, about two EuroLeague standard deviations wide, so the model can flag this as a likely high-usage role but cannot pin an exact figure; the true shooting projection of 58.4% (interval 50.7%-66.2%) should not be relied on at all, since the model's error on that metric is no better than a simple league-average guess.
